text:
zoe: Quick thread  Cascade Insights case draft looks good but customer wants the quote tweaked and a short product screenshot. Legal needs exact quote text before we publish. Can we get sign-off by Thu?
sam: Paste the quote here please. Ill line-edit for tone.
zoe: Their comms provided: "Redwood reduced our end-to-end p95 latency by ~52% and lowered inference costs by close to 50%."
anya: Legal redline: change '~52%' -> 'approximately 52%' and 'close to 50%' -> 'approximately 50%'. Need an email from Cascade confirming logo usage and permission to publish translated versions (FR/ES). No raw revenue numbers.
dave: Design will prep a neutral hero slide and one screenshot (redwood UI + anonymized dashboard). Need svg logo + headshot.
maria: Ops: route webinar leads to NA_AE queue and set hidden field campaign=cascade_insights. Also set nurture to 3 emails with CTA=book-demo.
ops-bot: Routing applied. Lead owner tag @maria.
zoe: I asked Cascade for the exact publish date and the approval email with logo & translation permission. Asked them to confirm recording ok for the webinar.
calendar-bot: Tentative event created  "Cascade Insights webinar" May 4 11:00 PT  invites: zoe,sam,dave,anya,maria
sam: Once we have the signed email, Ill post the final quote here and legal can stamp. Also will prep a 10-15s soundbite from the CTO during the webinar.
anya: On standby. If approval lands by Wed EOD, legal signs off for May 4 publish. :thumbsup:
zoe: Checklist: 1) Approval email + logo + translation permission (zoe) 2) Legal sign-off (anya) 3) Assets uploaded (cascade/shared) (dave) 4) Landing page + routing (maria) 5) Recording & short soundbite (sam). Ill update thread when Cascade replies. :pray:
